ai.headline: LinkedIn expands data sharing with Microsoft and its affiliates for ads and services
ai.summary: LinkedIn may now share your personal data with Microsoft and its affiliates to develop their advertising services, and may share your public posts with them subject to a European privacy notice. It also says it may receive information from Microsoft about your activity on Microsoft sites, and that it may collect device information through Microsoft cookies outside the Designated Countries.
